answer: The sparrow counter is kept in nectar and jade reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 503 identities would post 1661 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
